Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterprets the correct data extracted by WebSurfer by erroneously combining two distinct 2009 entries (Cantora 1 and Cantora 2) into a single album, resulting in an incorrect count of 2 instead of 3.   -- Result: Decision to use WebSurfer to open the Mercedes Sosa Wikipedia page and navigate to the Discography section.
- Agent: User
  -- Action: Provided the initial task and available capabilities.

  -- Result: Task definition and capability list provided to Planner.

The Subtask Name: Data Retrieval via Web Browsing
Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Opened the Mercedes Sosa Wikipedia page and scrolled down to view the Discography section.
  -- Observation: Initially saw the top of the page (Life section), then scrolled to see the Discography header and early studio albums (1962-1972).
  -- Thought: Need to find the 2000s entries; currently only seeing early albums.
  -- Result: Confirmed the page structure and identified the need to scroll further.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Directed WebSurfer to scroll further and locate 2000s entries.
  -- Observation: WebSurfer reported seeing albums up to 1972.
  -- Thought: The 2000s data is not yet visible; need to continue scrolling or use Find.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to scroll further or use Find to locate 2000-2009 entries.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Scrolled down further and clicked on the "Studio albums" anchor to jump to that section.
  -- Observation: Viewed the Studio albums table starting from 1962 up to 1987.
  -- Thought: Still missing the 2000s data; need to continue scrolling.
  -- Result: Reported seeing albums up to 1987.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Directed WebSurfer to use the Find function or continue scrolling to locate 2000s entries.
  -- Observation: WebSurfer reported seeing albums up to 1987.
  -- Thought: The 2000s data must be further down; need to ensure all entries are captured.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to search for "200" or scroll further.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Scrolled down further and viewed the lower part of the Studio albums table.
  -- Observation: Found entries for 1993-1999, then 2005 (Corazón Libre), 2009 (Cantora 1, Cantora 2), and later 2011/2015.
  -- Thought: Identified the relevant 2000s entries: 2005 and 2009.
  -- Result: Reported the visible 2000s studio albums.
